steps.content:
10:00 a.m.
The Fifth Avenue Public Security Bureau, Eastside
Are you ready, Chief?
...Alright then. Three, two, one, action!
[Public Security Bureau]

The lights are suddenly switched to full brightness. Everyone in the Public Security Bureau holds their breath looking at you. The sheriff in front of you clears her throat, mustering an authoritative voice as she turns on the camera facing you...
I am Roxanne, Technology Officer of the Public Security Bureau. I will now begin questioning you about the missing person cases.

steps.speaker: Roxanne
steps.content: You must give truthful answers to all my questions. Anything you say can be used against you in court.

steps.speaker: Roxanne
steps.content: State your name.

steps.speaker: Roxanne
steps.content: Gender?

steps.speaker: Roxanne
steps.content: Ahem, okay. Male.

steps.speaker: Roxanne
steps.content: Where were you at 3:20 p.m. yesterday?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Everyone at the MBCC can vouch for me.
She pulls out a stack of photos.

steps.speaker: Roxanne
steps.content: Do you recognize this person? <color=#fb9259>Mavik</color>. 35 years old. A retired mercenary. He was suspected of providing illegal immigration channels between Eastside and Syndicate to civilians, but was later released due to insufficient evidence.

You carefully review the documents handed over by Roxanne. According to the report, Mavik disappeared yesterday afternoon and the last contact he made was at 3:20 p.m. yesterday. Mavik's phone has been found in a dark alley. There were minor signs of struggle but no residue of Mania contamination at the scene.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But someone is adamantly accusing me of causing his and several other citizens' disappearances. Yes, on that Gray Mirror app.

steps.speaker: Roxanne
steps.content: Then do you know who put you up for a vote on Gray Mirror?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: All I know is a user ID, <color=#fb9259>Hot Toddy_815</color>. According to the posting time on Gray Mirror, this person seems to have confirmed Mavik's disappearance and taken photos of the scene before the Public Security Bureau did.

steps.speaker: Roxanne
steps.content: What about the accusations made by <color=#fb9259>Hot Toddy_815</color> on Gray Mirror against you? Do you admit to them?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Everything I did at each Mania incident scene is in the classified files. You can confirm that with the MBCC or the 9th Agency.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: As for the missing person cases, take Mavik for instance, I had neither the time nor the motive. I couldn't have traveled from the Bureau to Eastside in such a short time.

steps.speaker: Roxanne
steps.content: Well said. I think so too.
Roxanne pauses the recording and exhales deeply.

steps.speaker: Roxanne
steps.content: Alright, our procedure here is done! The MBCC has also sent over your alibi. It's all good!

steps.speaker: Roxanne
steps.content: Guys, you can unmute now!

She claps her hands vigorously and calls out to the office, and the atmosphere finally lightens. Several sheriffs peek at you curiously with a funny smile, seemingly marveling at "Minos' boss likes to be interogated".

You smile back at them. You don't need to explain anything now that the reports of those disappearance cases are already in hand. Going through formal channels for the files might attract unwanted attention from the Public Security Bureau big shots, but requesting it personally simplifies everything.

steps.speaker: Roxanne
steps.content: We get a dozen of missing persons on a daily basis here in Eastside, so I didn't expect... such a meeting request from you, Chief. Are you bothered by that vote against you on Gray Mirror?

options: Yes, it spooks me a little.
I'm curious. Never seen something like that before.

steps.speaker: Roxanne
steps.content: I guess you're too overworked to have time to go on the internet, huh? Relax, Chief. After all, those are not Syndican gangs or Corruptors. They can't hurt you physically.

steps.speaker: Roxanne
steps.content: Gray Mirror is circulated on the dark web, but it has nothing to do with those illegal transactions or murder-for-hire. It's just another social media where you can start new topics and discussions with a little extra "Vote" feature as its gimmick. It remains an app catering to minority interests.

steps.speaker: Roxanne
steps.content: Speaking of its relevance to the disappearance cases... Recently, some urban legends have been circulating online. We've followed up on them, and these are what we found...
She picks up her phone and hands it to you after a few swipes. Several flashy headlines pop into your view.

Beware! The Hidden Crisis of Gray Mirror: The Internet Will Swallow You Whole! By Red Fruity Sun A Warning for the Youth: Online Justice Could Cost You Your Life! By No Longer A Fruit Who's Really Controlling You? True Stories of Devoured Anonymous Users on Sinister App! By Apple_World Domination From Screen to Life: The Mystery behind an Emerging Social App and Real-Life Disappearance Cases By DEVILFRUITMECHA-01

steps.speaker: Roxanne
steps.content: All we've found are just clickbait articles like these. If you've got the time to waste, I can consolidate them and send them to you.

After thanking her, you open Gray Mirror. You check the discussions about you before briefly scanning those content farm articles. Indeed, most of them are sensational and misleading. They are not even credible enough to provide any new clues and are not as interesting as that vote against you on Gray Mirror.

That Exterminator vote was the first to publish photos of the scene of Mavik's disappearance, even before the Public Security Bureau. If only you could find the poster... Gray Mirror guarantees absolute anonymity, and their encryption technology has withstood your technicians' tests, matching DisMyth's deep layer security. They likely share the same framework.

As you watch the Exterminator post surge in Virality, more doubts start emerging in your mind. You begin formulating plans to locate Hot Toddy_815. Could this be an entry point into the dark web hidden behind all this?
